verdict.rationale: Veriff's API supports core verification flows (create sessions, decisions, webhooks, HMAC auth) fully documented, but manual review of verification sessions is explicitly UI-only via the Customer Portal (docs-12, docs-13, docs-26) with no documented API equivalent, and no OpenAPI/swagger spec is discoverable (probe-2 returns 404s), suggesting incomplete API parity with UI capabilities like PDF export and manual review. missing for 10: API equivalent for manual review/decision overrides, discoverable OpenAPI spec, API-driven PDF export confirmation.
